meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以调用本地运行的 Ollama 模型，让本地模型处理任务并返回结果；还能列出已装模型。若开启管理选项，可拉取、删除模型或查看模型信息。
howto.when: 当你说出“ollama”等关键词，或请求调用本地模型、管理模型库时触发。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都是什么
say.note: 会列出模型并用本地模型生成回答
需开启管理工具，会下载该模型

say.text: 哪些 Ollama 模型正在内存中运行？
say.note: 需开启管理工具，会显示运行中模型

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can call local Ollama models through an MCP server. It can list installed models and generate responses with them; if management tools are enabled, it can also pull, delete, show, and list running models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions Ollama or asks to use local models, or (if management tools are enabled) requests pulling, deleting, or inspecting models.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models and generates a response via a local model.
Downloads the model if admin tools are enabled.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are currently loaded in memory?
say_en.note: Shows running models if admin tools are enabled.
